texts.preamble: Sundaravalli vs The District Collector on 23 June, 2025 Author: N. Anand Venkatesh Bench: N. Anand Venkatesh In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated : 23.06.2025 Coram The Honourable Mr.JUSTICE N. Anand Venkatesh W.P.No.22207 of 2025 Sundaravalli Vs. 1.The District Collector District Collector Office Kallakurichi 606 202 2.The Designated Officer The Tamil Nadu Food Safety and Drug Administration Department (Kallakurichi) Collectorate Building Kallakurichi District 605 602 3.The Branch Manager Indian Overseas Bank (Iob) Ulundurpet, Virudhachalam Road Kallakurichi District 606107
texts.facts: This writ petition has been filed for a direction to the respondents 2 and 3 to defreeze the savings bank account of the petitioner maintained with the rd 3 respondent. th 3. The 4 respondent registered an FIR in Crime No.18/2025 for offence under Cigarette and Other Tobacco Products Acts, 2003. The shop was sealed and rd the bank account of the petitioner maintained with the 3 respondent was also https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 25/06/2025 02:31:25 pm ) freezed. The petitioner paid the fine amount and later, the shop was desealed. However, freezing of the bank account continued and it is under these circumstances, the present writ petition has been filed before this Court.
